arguments.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.Piecewise a b u → ∃ p : Finset ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, t ∉ p → ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => u r k) (KdVPlan.dt u t k) t
arguments.proof:
classical
intro a b u hu
rcases hu.2 with ⟨p,hp⟩
refine ⟨p,?_⟩
intro t ht htp k
have hopen : IsOpen (Set.Ioo a b \ (p : Set ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioo.sdiff p.finite_toSet.isClosed
have hnh : Set.Ioo a b \ (p : Set ℝ) ∈ nhds t := hopen.mem_nhds ⟨ht,htp⟩
rcases exists_Icc_mem_subset_of_mem_nhds hnh with ⟨l,r,htri,hnhlr,hlrsub⟩
have hti : t ∈ Set.Ioo l r := Icc_mem_nhds_iff.mp hnhlr
have hlr : l < r := hti.1.trans hti.2
have hal : a ≤ l := (hlrsub ⟨le_rfl,hlr.le⟩).1.1.le
have hrb : r ≤ b := (hlrsub ⟨hlr.le,le_rfl⟩).1.2.le
have hs := hp l r hal hlr hrb (by
  intro x hx hxi
  exact (hlrsub ⟨hxi.1.le,hxi.2.le⟩).2 hx)
have hn0 : (((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)) ≠ 0 := by simp
have hdiff := ((hs.1 k).differentiableOn hn0 t htri).differentiableAt hnhlr
exact hdiff.hasDerivAt

arguments.proof:
intro s a b u hu
filter_upwards [hu.2.1,ENNReal.ae_le_essSup (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)) (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (KdVPlan.hn s (u t)))] with t ht hle
refine ⟨ht,?_⟩
have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ne_of_lt hu.2.2) hle
rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (show 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn s (u t) from Real.sqrt_nonneg _)] at hreal
exact hreal

51:   rw [← le_floor_iff ha, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, ← floor_lt ha, Nat.lt_add_one_iff,

∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
(∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ)*τ ≤ t ∧ t < ((KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ)+1)*τ) ∧
(∀ n : ℕ, KdVPlan.gridIndex τ ((n : ℝ)*τ)=n) ∧
(∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ico ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) → KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t=n) ∧
(∀ (L : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) → KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t ≤ L)
arguments.proof:
intro τ hτ
have h0 : ∀ n : ℕ, KdVPlan.gridIndex τ ((n : ℝ)*τ)=n := by
  intro n
  simp [KdVPlan.gridIndex,hτ.ne']
refine ⟨?_,h0,?_,?_⟩
· intro t ht
  have hlo := Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg ht hτ.le)
  have hhi := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (t/τ)
  exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hτ).mp hlo,(div_lt_iff₀ hτ).mp hhi⟩
· intro n t ht
  unfold KdVPlan.gridIndex
  apply Nat.floor_eq_on_Ico n
  exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hτ).mpr ht.1,(div_lt_iff₀ hτ).mpr ht.2⟩
· intro L t ht
  have hm := Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ht.2 hτ.le)
  simpa [KdVPlan.gridIndex,hτ.ne'] using hm

∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) →
KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t = KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t ∧
∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.interp τ f r k) ((KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.interp τ f t) (KdVPlan.interp τ f t))+KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t) k) t
arguments.proof:
intro τ f hτ hf hs n t ht
have hcell : t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) ((n : ℝ)*τ+τ) := by constructor <;> nlinarith only [ht.1,ht.2]
have hnum := @yui_aux_0111 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ hf hs n
have hd := @yui_aux_0078 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) hτ hnum.1 hnum.2 t hcell
have he := @yui_aux_0112 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ n t hτ ht
have hflo := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).2.2.1 n t ⟨ht.1.le,ht.2⟩
have hR : KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t = KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t := by
  ext k
  have hρ := (hd k).2.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have h := (hasDerivAt_const t ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, KdVPlan.rho ((j : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f j) (((j : ℝ)+1)*τ)) k)).add hρ
  have h' : HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.residual τ f r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t k) t := by
    apply (by simpa only [zero_add] using h).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [he] with r hr
    simp only [KdVPlan.residual,hr,Pi.add_apply]
  exact h'.deriv
refine ⟨hR,?_⟩
intro k
have hV := (hd k).1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
have hvrel := (@yui_aux_0080 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) hτ hnum.1 hnum.2 t hcell).1
rw [hvrel] at hV
have hV' : HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.interp τ f r k) ((KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) t) (KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) t))+KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t) k) t := by
  apply hV.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [he] with r hr
  simp only [KdVPlan.interp,hr]
simpa only [KdVPlan.interp,hflo,hR] using hV'

∀ (τ : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), 0 < τ → KdVPlan.Data 0 f → KdVPlan.Smooth f →
∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) →
KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t = KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t ∧
∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.interp τ f r k) ((KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.interp τ f t) (KdVPlan.interp τ f t))+KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t) k) t
arguments.proof:
intro τ f hτ hf hs n t ht
have hcell : t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) ((n : ℝ)*τ+τ) := by constructor <;> nlinarith only [ht.1,ht.2]
have hnum := @yui_aux_0111 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ hf hs n
have hd := @yui_aux_0078 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) hτ hnum.1 hnum.2 t hcell
have he := @yui_aux_0112 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ n t hτ ht
have hflo := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).2.2.1 n t ⟨ht.1.le,ht.2⟩
have hR : KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t = KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t := by
  ext k
  have hρ := (hd k).2.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have h := (hasDerivAt_const t ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, KdVPlan.rho ((j : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f j) (((j : ℝ)+1)*τ)) k)).add hρ
  have h' : HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.residual τ f r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t k) t := by
    simp only [zero_add] at h
    apply h.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [he] with r hr
    simp only [KdVPlan.residual,hr,Pi.add_apply]
  exact h'.deriv
refine ⟨hR,?_⟩
intro k
have hV := (hd k).1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
have hvrel := (@yui_aux_0080 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) hτ hnum.1 hnum.2 t hcell).1
change HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t k) t at hV
rw [hvrel] at hV
have hV' : HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.interp τ f r k) ((KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) t) (KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) t))+KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t) k) t := by
  apply hV.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [he] with r hr
  simp only [KdVPlan.interp,hr]
simpa only [KdVPlan.interp,hflo,hR] using hV'

arguments.statement:
∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ), 0 < τ → ∃ p : Finset ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ), t ∉ p →
KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t < L ∧ t ∈ Set.Ioo ((KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ)*τ) (((KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ)+1)*τ)
arguments.proof:
classical
intro τ L hτ
let p := (Finset.range (L+1)).image (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)*τ)
refine ⟨p,?_⟩
intro t ht htp
have hidx := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).2.2.2 L t ht
have hb := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).1 t ht.1
have hne : (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ)*τ ≠ t := by
  intro he
  apply htp
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t,Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega),he⟩
have hlo : (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ)*τ < t := lt_of_le_of_ne hb.1 hne
refine ⟨?_,hlo,hb.2⟩
by_contra hn
have he : KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t=L := by omega
rw [he] at hlo
linarith only [hlo,ht.2]

arguments.statement:
∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (d : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ), 0 < τ →
AEStronglyMeasurable d (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))) →
(∀ n, ContinuousOn (D n) (Set.Icc ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ))) →
(∀ n t, t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) → d t = D n t) →
IntegrableOn d (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))
arguments.proof:
classical
intro τ L d D hτ hd hD he
have hb : ∀ n, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ), ‖D n t‖ ≤ C := by
  intro n
  rcases isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hD n) with ⟨C,hC⟩
  exact ⟨max 0 C,le_max_left _ _,fun t ht => (hC t ht).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
choose C hC0 hC using hb
rcases @yui_aux_0114 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L hτ with ⟨p,hp⟩
apply IntegrableOn.of_bound (by simp) hd (∑ n ∈ Finset.range L, C n)
have hpn : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))), t ∉ (p : Set ℝ) :=
  (p.finite_toSet.countable.ae_notMem volume).filter_mono (Measure.ae_mono Measure.restrict_le_self)
filter_upwards [hpn,ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t htp ht
have hcell := hp t ht htp
rw [he _ _ hcell.2]
exact (hC _ t ⟨hcell.2.1.le,hcell.2.2.le⟩).trans
  (Finset.single_le_sum (fun n _ => hC0 n) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hcell.1))

∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (d : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ), 0 < τ →
AEStronglyMeasurable d (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))) →
(∀ n, ContinuousOn (D n) (Set.Icc ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ))) →
(∀ n t, t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) → d t = D n t) →
IntegrableOn d (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))
result.proof:
classical
intro τ L d D hτ hd hD he
have hb : ∀ n, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ), ‖D n t‖ ≤ C := by
  intro n
  rcases isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hD n) with ⟨C,hC⟩
  exact ⟨max 0 C,le_max_left _ _,fun t ht => (hC t ht).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
choose C hC0 hC using hb
rcases @yui_aux_0114 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L hτ with ⟨p,hp⟩
apply IntegrableOn.of_bound (by simp) hd (∑ n ∈ Finset.range L, C n)
have hpn : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))), t ∉ (p : Set ℝ) :=
  (p.finite_toSet.countable.ae_notMem volume).filter_mono (Measure.ae_mono Measure.restrict_le_self)
filter_upwards [hpn,ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t htp ht
have hcell := hp t ht htp
rw [he _ _ hcell.2]
exact (hC _ t ⟨hcell.2.1.le,hcell.2.2.le⟩).trans
  (Finset.single_le_sum (fun n _ => hC0 n) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hcell.1))

arguments.statement:
∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (d : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ), 0 < τ →
AEStronglyMeasurable d (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))) →
(∀ n, ContinuousOn (D n) (Set.Icc ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ))) →
(∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) → d t = D n t) →
IntegrableOn d (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))
arguments.proof:
classical
intro τ L d D hτ hd hD he
have hb : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ), ‖D n t‖ ≤ C := by
  intro n
  rcases isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hD n) with ⟨C,hC⟩
  exact ⟨max 0 C,le_max_left _ _,fun t ht => (hC t ht).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
choose C hC0 hC using hb
rcases @yui_aux_0114 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L hτ with ⟨p,hp⟩
apply IntegrableOn.of_bound isCompact_Icc.measure_lt_top hd (∑ n ∈ Finset.range L, C n)
have hpn : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ))), t ∉ (p : Set ℝ) :=
  ae_mono Measure.restrict_le_self (p.finite_toSet.countable.ae_notMem volume)
filter_upwards [hpn,ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t htp ht
have hcell := hp t ht htp
rw [he _ _ hcell.2]
exact (hC _ t ⟨hcell.2.1.le,hcell.2.2.le⟩).trans
  (Finset.single_le_sum (fun n _ => hC0 n) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hcell.1))

let D : ℕ → KdVPlan.Path := fun n t =>
 KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n))+
 KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (KdVPlan.F ((n : ℝ)*τ) (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) t)+
 KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.F ((n : ℝ)*τ) (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) t) (KdVPlan.F ((n : ℝ)*τ) (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) t))-
 KdVPlan.scale ((τ : ℂ)⁻¹) (KdVPlan.Wst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n))
refine ⟨D,?_,?_⟩
· intro n k
  have hn := @yui_aux_0111 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ hf hs n
  have hF : KdVPlan.ContH 0 ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) (KdVPlan.F ((n : ℝ)*τ) (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) := by

    convert h using 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have hc := @yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0 ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) hn.1.1
  have h1 := @yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 _ _ _ _ hc hc k
  have h2 := @yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 _ _ _ _ hc hF k
  have h3 := @yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 _ _ _ _ hF hF k
  exact (((h1.const_mul (1/2)).add h2).add (h3.const_mul (1/2))).sub continuousOn_const
· intro n t ht
  have hn := @yui_aux_0111 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ hf hs n
  have hcell : t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) ((n : ℝ)*τ+τ) := by constructor <;> nlinarith only [ht.1,ht.2]
  have hd := @yui_aux_0078 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ _ hτ hn.1 hn.2 t hcell
  have hR := (@yui_aux_0113 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ hf hs n t ht).1
  have hV := (@yui_aux_0080 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ _ hτ hn.1 hn.2 t hcell).1
  have hflo := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).2.2.1 n t ⟨ht.1.le,ht.2⟩
  rw [hR]
  change KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ _ t) (KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ _ t))+_=_ at hV
  have hipt : KdVPlan.interp τ f t = KdVPlan.Vst ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) t := by simp only [KdVPlan.interp,hflo]
  rw [hipt,← hV]
  ext k
  exact (hd k).1.deriv

∀ (τ : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), 0 < τ → KdVPlan.Data 0 f → KdVPlan.Smooth f →

helper.statement:
∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), 0 < τ → KdVPlan.Data 0 f → KdVPlan.Smooth f →
KdVPlan.Weak 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) (KdVPlan.interp τ f)
(fun t => KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.interp τ f t) (KdVPlan.interp τ f t))+KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t)

arguments.statement:
(∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → ContinuousOn (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) (Set.Icc a b)) ∧
(∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → KdVPlan.UB s a b u (KdVPlan.SupH s a b u) ∧ 0 ≤ KdVPlan.SupH s a b u)
arguments.proof:
have hcont : ∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → ContinuousOn (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) (Set.Icc a b) := by
  intro s a b u hu
  rcases @yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 s with ⟨L,hL,hLd⟩
  have hc := (@yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 s a b L hLd u hu).norm
  apply hc.congr
  intro t ht
  exact (hL (u t) (hu.1 t ht)).2
refine ⟨hcont,?_⟩
intro s a b u hab hu
have hset : {x : ℝ | ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, x=KdVPlan.hn s (u t)} =
  (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) '' Set.Icc a b := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,he⟩
    exact ⟨t,ht,he.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,he⟩
    exact ⟨t,ht,he.symm⟩
have hb : BddAbove {x : ℝ | ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, x=KdVPlan.hn s (u t)} := by
  rw [hset]
  exact (isCompact_Icc.image_of_continuousOn (hcont s a b u hu)).bddAbove
have hle : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, KdVPlan.hn s (u t) ≤ KdVPlan.SupH s a b u :=
  fun t ht => le_csSup hb ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
refine ⟨fun t ht => ⟨hu.1 t ht,hle t ht⟩,?_⟩
exact (show 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn s (u a) from Real.sqrt_nonneg _).trans (hle a ⟨le_rfl,hab⟩)

(∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → ContinuousOn (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) (Set.Icc a b)) ∧
(∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → KdVPlan.UB s a b u (KdVPlan.SupH s a b u) ∧ 0 ≤ KdVPlan.SupH s a b u)
result.proof:
have hcont : ∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → ContinuousOn (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) (Set.Icc a b) := by
  intro s a b u hu
  rcases @yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 s with ⟨L,hL,hLd⟩
  have hc := (@yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 s a b L hLd u hu).norm
  apply hc.congr
  intro t ht
  exact (hL (u t) (hu.1 t ht)).2
refine ⟨hcont,?_⟩
intro s a b u hab hu
have hset : {x : ℝ | ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, x=KdVPlan.hn s (u t)} =
  (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) '' Set.Icc a b := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,he⟩
    exact ⟨t,ht,he.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,he⟩
    exact ⟨t,ht,he.symm⟩
have hb : BddAbove {x : ℝ | ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, x=KdVPlan.hn s (u t)} := by
  rw [hset]
  exact (isCompact_Icc.image_of_continuousOn (hcont s a b u hu)).bddAbove
have hle : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, KdVPlan.hn s (u t) ≤ KdVPlan.SupH s a b u :=
  fun t ht => le_csSup hb ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
refine ⟨fun t ht => ⟨hu.1 t ht,hle t ht⟩,?_⟩
exact (show 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn s (u a) from Real.sqrt_nonneg _).trans (hle a ⟨le_rfl,hab⟩)

(∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → ContinuousOn (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) (Set.Icc a b)) ∧
(∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → KdVPlan.UB s a b u (KdVPlan.SupH s a b u) ∧ 0 ≤ KdVPlan.SupH s a b u)
arguments.proof:
have hcont : ∀ (s a b : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.ContH s a b u → ContinuousOn (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) (Set.Icc a b) := by
  intro s a b u hu
  rcases @yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 s with ⟨L,hL,hLd⟩
  have hc := (@yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 s a b L hLd u hu).norm
  apply hc.congr
  intro t ht
  exact (hL (u t) (hu.1 t ht)).2.symm
refine ⟨hcont,?_⟩
intro s a b u hab hu
have hset : {x : ℝ | ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, x=KdVPlan.hn s (u t)} =
  (fun t => KdVPlan.hn s (u t)) '' Set.Icc a b := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,he⟩
    exact ⟨t,ht,he.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,he⟩
    exact ⟨t,ht,he.symm⟩
have hb : BddAbove {x : ℝ | ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, x=KdVPlan.hn s (u t)} := by
  rw [hset]
  exact (isCompact_Icc.image_of_continuousOn (hcont s a b u hu)).bddAbove
have hle : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, KdVPlan.hn s (u t) ≤ KdVPlan.SupH s a b u :=
  fun t ht => le_csSup hb ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
refine ⟨fun t ht => ⟨hu.1 t ht,hle t ht⟩,?_⟩
exact (show 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn s (u a) from Real.sqrt_nonneg _).trans (hle a ⟨le_rfl,hab⟩)

arguments.statement:
∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ),
0 < τ → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b →
KdVPlan.ContH 0 a b v ∧ KdVPlan.ContH 0 a b (KdVPlan.interp τ f) ∧
KdVPlan.ContH 0 a b (KdVPlan.err τ f v) ∧ KdVPlan.UB 0 a b (KdVPlan.err τ f v) (KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v) ∧
0 ≤ KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ∧ KdVPlan.UB 0 a b v M ∧
KdVPlan.UB 0 a b (KdVPlan.interp τ f) (M+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)
arguments.proof:
intro M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg
have hs := htr.2.2.1
have hcv : KdVPlan.ContH 0 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) v := by
  simpa using hs.2 0 0
have hcp : KdVPlan.ContH 0 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) (KdVPlan.interp τ f) := by
  simpa using (h_T007.2.2.2 τ f L hτ htr.1 htr.2.1).1.1 0
have hv := (@yui_aux_0089 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).1 0 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) a b v hg.1 hg.2.2.1 hcv
have hp := (@yui_aux_0089 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).1 0 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) a b _ hg.1 hg.2.2.1 hcp
have he := @yui_aux_0119 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0 a b v (KdVPlan.interp τ f) hv hp
have hsup := (@yui_aux_0118 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).2 0 a b (KdVPlan.err τ f v) hg.2.1 he
have hvm : KdVPlan.UB 0 a b v M := by
  intro t ht
  have hγ := htr.2.2.2.2.1 t ⟨hg.1.trans ht.1,ht.2.trans hg.2.2.1⟩
  have hh := h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma (v t) h_H002.1.le hγ.1
  exact ⟨hh.1,hh.2.trans hγ.2⟩
refine ⟨hv,hp,he,hsup.1,hsup.2,hvm,?_⟩
intro t ht
have hb := ((@yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).1 0 M (KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v) (v t) (KdVPlan.err τ f v t) (hvm t ht) (hsup.1 t ht)).2
have heq : v t-KdVPlan.err τ f v t=KdVPlan.interp τ f t := by dsimp [KdVPlan.err]; abel
rwa [heq] at hb

helper.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.hn s (f-g)=KdVPlan.hn s (g-f)
helper.application: @yui_aux_0121 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013

arguments.statement:
∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 →
KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ L → (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b →
KdVPlan.StepData gamma M ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ∧
KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v
arguments.proof:
intro M τ L f v a b hM hτ hτ1 htr hg hE n hn ht
have hh := @yui_aux_0120 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg
have hnD := @yui_aux_0111 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ htr.1 htr.2.1 n
have htg : (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) := ⟨hg.1.trans ht.1,ht.2.trans hg.2.2.1⟩
have hvHB := htr.2.2.2.2.1 _ htg
have hvR := htr.2.2.2.1 _ htg
have hvS : KdVPlan.Smooth (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) := by
  intro m
  simpa using (htr.2.2.1.2 m 0).1 ((n : ℝ)*τ) htg
have hgrid := (h_T007.2.2.2 τ f L hτ htr.1 htr.2.1).2.2 n hn
have hdist : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n-v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ≤ KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v := by
  rw [@yui_aux_0121 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0]
  have h := (hh.2.2.2.1 _ ht).2
  simpa only [KdVPlan.err,hgrid] using h
refine ⟨⟨hM,by positivity,hτ,hτ1,hnD.1,⟨hvHB.1,hvR⟩,hnD.2,hvS,hvHB.2,hdist.trans hE⟩,?_⟩
exact add_le_add_left hdist _

KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ L → (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b →
KdVPlan.StepData gamma M ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ∧
KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v
result.proof:
intro M τ L f v a b hM hτ hτ1 htr hg hE n hn ht
have hh := @yui_aux_0120 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg
have hnD := @yui_aux_0111 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ htr.1 htr.2.1 n
have htg : (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) := ⟨hg.1.trans ht.1,ht.2.trans hg.2.2.1⟩
have hvHB := htr.2.2.2.2.1 _ htg
have hvR := htr.2.2.2.1 _ htg
have hvS : KdVPlan.Smooth (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) := by
  intro m
  simpa using (htr.2.2.1.2 m 0).1 ((n : ℝ)*τ) htg
have hgrid := (h_T007.2.2.2 τ f L hτ htr.1 htr.2.1).2.2 n hn
have hdist : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n-v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ≤ KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v := by
  rw [@yui_aux_0121 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0]
  have h := (hh.2.2.2.1 _ ht).2
  simpa only [KdVPlan.err,hgrid] using h
refine ⟨⟨hM,by positivity,hτ,hτ1,hnD.1,⟨hvHB.1,hvR⟩,hnD.2,hvS,hvHB.2,hdist.trans hE⟩,?_⟩
exact add_le_add_left hdist _

arguments.statement:
∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 →
KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ L → (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b →
KdVPlan.StepData gamma M ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ∧
KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v
arguments.proof:
intro M τ L f v a b hM hτ hτ1 htr hg hE n hn ht
have hh := @yui_aux_0120 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg
have hnD := @yui_aux_0111 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ htr.1 htr.2.1 n
have htg : (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) := ⟨hg.1.trans ht.1,ht.2.trans hg.2.2.1⟩
have hvHB := htr.2.2.2.2.1 _ htg
have hvR := htr.2.2.2.1 _ htg
have hvS : KdVPlan.Smooth (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) := by
  intro m
  simpa using (htr.2.2.1.2 m 0).1 ((n : ℝ)*τ) htg
have hgrid := (h_T007.2.2.2 τ f L hτ htr.1 htr.2.1).2.2 n hn
have hdist : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n-v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ≤ KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v := by
  rw [@yui_aux_0121 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0]
  have h := (hh.2.2.2.1 _ ht).2
  simpa only [KdVPlan.err,hgrid] using h
refine ⟨⟨hM,by positivity,hτ,hτ1,hnD.1,⟨hvHB.1,hvR⟩,hnD.2,hvS,hvHB.2,hdist.trans hE⟩,?_⟩
exact add_le_add le_rfl hdist

helper.statement:
∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 →
KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ L → (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b →
KdVPlan.StepData gamma M ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ∧
KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n) (v ((n : ℝ)*τ)) ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v

arguments.statement:
∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (a b t : ℝ), 0 < τ → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → t ∈ Set.Icc a b →
KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t ≤ L ∧ ((KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ)*τ) ∈ Set.Icc a b
arguments.proof:
intro τ L a b t hτ hg ht
rcases hg with ⟨ha,hab,hb,n,hn,rfl⟩
have htg : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) := ⟨ha.trans ht.1,ht.2.trans hb⟩
have hidx := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).2.2.2 L t htg
have hge : n ≤ KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t := by
  have hh := Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ht.1 hτ.le)
  simpa [KdVPlan.gridIndex,hτ.ne'] using hh
have hcast : (n : ℝ) ≤ (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hge
refine ⟨hidx,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcast hτ.le,?_⟩
exact ((@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).1 t htg.1).1.trans ht.2

arguments.statement:
∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ),
0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
KdVPlan.EssBound (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f)) ∧
KdVPlan.EssH (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f)) ≤ C*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)
arguments.proof:
classical
intro M hM
rcases @yui_aux_0104 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M hM with ⟨C,hC,hCl⟩
refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
intro τ L f v a b hτ hτ1 htr hg hE
have hq0 : 0 ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v :=
  add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le _) (@yui_aux_0120 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg).2.2.2.2.1
have hgrid := @yui_aux_0122 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hM hτ hτ1 htr hg hE
have hnB : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ t ∂volume, n ≤ L → (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b →
 t ∈ Set.Icc ((n : ℝ)*τ) ((n : ℝ)*τ+τ) →
 KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.rho ((n : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f n)) t) (C*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) := by
  intro n
  by_cases hvalid : n ≤ L ∧ (n : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b
  · have hs := hgrid n hvalid.1 hvalid.2
    have hr := hCl _ _ _ _ hs.1
    have hae := @yui_aux_0108 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) ((n : ℝ)*τ) ((n : ℝ)*τ+τ) _ hr.2.2.1
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc] at hae
    filter_upwards [hae] with t ht
    intro hn hnt hti
    have hb := ht hti
    refine ⟨hb.1,hb.2.trans (hr.2.2.2.trans ?_)⟩
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 hC.le
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t hn hnt _ => (hvalid ⟨hn,hnt⟩).elim)
rcases @yui_aux_0114 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L hτ with ⟨p,hp⟩
have hae : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)),
 KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t) (C*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) := by
  rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc]
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hnB,p.finite_toSet.countable.ae_notMem volume] with t ht htp
  intro hti
  have hcell := hp t ⟨hg.1.trans hti.1,hti.2.trans hg.2.2.1⟩ htp
  have hidx := @yui_aux_0123 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L a b t hτ hg hti
  rw [(@yui_aux_0113 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f hτ htr.1 htr.2.1 _ t hcell.2).1]
  apply ht _ hidx.1 hidx.2
  exact ⟨hcell.2.1.le,by nlinarith only [hcell.2.2]⟩
have he := @yui_aux_0013 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b (C*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) _ (mul_nonneg hC.le hq0) hae
refine ⟨⟨fun k => (stronglyMeasurable_deriv (fun t => KdVPlan.residual τ f t k)).aestronglyMeasurable,hae.mono (fun _ h => h.1),he.1⟩,he.2⟩

arguments.statement:
∀ (τ : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 0 < τ → (n : ℝ)*τ ≤ t →
KdVPlan.residual τ f t-KdVPlan.residual τ f ((n : ℝ)*τ) =
(∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico n (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t), KdVPlan.rho ((j : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f j) (((j : ℝ)+1)*τ))+
KdVPlan.rho ((KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t)) t
arguments.proof:
intro τ f n t hτ ht
have hgrid := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).2.1 n
have hge : n ≤ KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t := by
  have hh := Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ht hτ.le)
  simpa [KdVPlan.gridIndex,hτ.ne'] using hh
simp only [KdVPlan.residual,hgrid,@yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013,add_zero]
rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hge]
abel

arguments.statement:
∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ),
0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
KdVPlan.UB 0 a b (fun t => KdVPlan.residual τ f t-KdVPlan.residual τ f a)
(C*(b-a+τ)*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v))
arguments.proof:
intro M hM
rcases @yui_aux_0104 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M hM with ⟨C,hC,hCl⟩
refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
intro τ L f v a b hτ hτ1 htr hg hE t ht
have hq0 : 0 ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v :=
  add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le _) (@yui_aux_0120 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg).2.2.2.2.1
have hgrid := @yui_aux_0122 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hM hτ hτ1 htr hg hE
have hidx := @yui_aux_0123 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L a b t hτ hg ht
rcases hg.2.2.2 with ⟨n0,hn0,ha⟩
have hge : n0 ≤ KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t := by
  have hh := Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (show (n0 : ℝ)*τ ≤ t by rwa [← ha]) hτ.le)
  simpa [KdVPlan.gridIndex,hτ.ne'] using hh
have hbidx := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).1 t (hg.1.trans ht.1)
have hρ : ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ L → (j : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b →
∀ r ∈ Set.Icc ((j : ℝ)*τ) ((j : ℝ)*τ+τ), KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.rho ((j : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f j) r) (C*τ*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) := by
  intro j hj hjt r hr
  have hs := hgrid j hj hjt
  have hb := (hCl _ _ _ _ hs.1).2.1 r hr
  exact ⟨hb.1,hb.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 (mul_nonneg hC.le hτ.le))⟩
have hsum := @yui_aux_0125 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0 (C*τ*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) (Finset.Ico n0 (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t))
 (fun j => KdVPlan.rho ((j : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f j) (((j : ℝ)+1)*τ)) (by
  intro j hj
  have hj' := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj
  have hjL : j ≤ L := (Nat.le_of_lt hj'.2).trans hidx.1
  have hcastlo : (n0 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj'.1
  have hcasthi : (j : ℝ) ≤ (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt hj'.2)
  have hjt : (j : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b := ⟨by rw [ha]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcastlo hτ.le,
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcasthi hτ.le).trans hidx.2.2⟩
  apply hρ j hjL hjt (((j : ℝ)+1)*τ)
  constructor <;> nlinarith only [hτ])
have hlast := hρ _ hidx.1 hidx.2 t ⟨hbidx.1,by nlinarith only [hbidx.2]⟩
have hb := ((@yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).1 0 _ _ _ _ hsum hlast).1
rw [show (fun t => KdVPlan.residual τ f t-KdVPlan.residual τ f a) t =
  KdVPlan.residual τ f t-KdVPlan.residual τ f ((n0 : ℝ)*τ) by rw [← ha],
 @yui_aux_0126 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f n0 t hτ (by rwa [← ha])]
refine ⟨hb.1,hb.2.trans ?_⟩
have hcount : (((Finset.Ico n0 (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t)).card : ℝ)+1)*τ ≤ b-a+τ := by
  rw [Nat.card_Ico,Nat.cast_sub hge]
  rw [ha]
  nlinarith only [hidx.2.2]
have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount (mul_nonneg hC.le hq0)
nlinarith only [hh]

have he := (@yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0 v V hv hV).1
have hh := (@yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0 (v-V) (1/2) he).1

have hsym := (@yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).2.1
have h1 := (hsub t v V v hv hV hv).1
have h2 := (hsub t v V V hv hV hV).2
have h3 := (hsub t v V (v-V) hv hV he).1
have h4 := (hsub t v (KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (v-V)) (v-V) hv hh he).2
have hone : KdVPlan.scale 1 (v-V)=v-V := by ext k; simp [KdVPlan.scale]

 KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (v-V) (v-V)) := by

have hc3 := congrFun h3 k

arguments.statement:
∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path), 0 < τ → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v →
∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) → t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) →
KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v) t =
KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.err τ f v t) (v t-KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.err τ f v t))-KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t
arguments.proof:
intro M τ L f v hτ htr n t ht htG
have hs := htr.2.2.1
have hcv : KdVPlan.ContH 0 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) v := by simpa using hs.2 0 0
have hcp : KdVPlan.ContH 0 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) (KdVPlan.interp τ f) := by
  simpa using (h_T007.2.2.2 τ f L hτ htr.1 htr.2.1).1.1 0
have hvM := hcv.1 t ⟨htG.1.le,htG.2.le⟩

    KdVPlan.BilinearOutput →

helper.statement:
∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path), 0 < τ → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v →
∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo ((n : ℝ)*τ) (((n : ℝ)+1)*τ) → t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) →
KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v) t =
KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.err τ f v t) (v t-KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.err τ f v t))-KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t

arguments.statement:
∀ (a b A D : ℝ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ D →
KdVPlan.ContH 0 a b u → KdVPlan.UB 0 a b u A →
(∃ p : Finset ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, t ∉ p → ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => u r k) (KdVPlan.dt u t k) t) →
(∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)), KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.dt u t) D) →
KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b u (KdVPlan.dt u) ∧ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b u (KdVPlan.dt u) ≤ A+D
arguments.proof:
intro a b A D u hab hA hD hc hub hdiff hae
have hu := @yui_aux_0090 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0 a b A u hA hc hub
have hd := @yui_aux_0013 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b D (KdVPlan.dt u) hD hae
have hdm : ∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => KdVPlan.dt u t k) (volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)) :=
  fun k => (stronglyMeasurable_deriv (fun t => u t k)).aestronglyMeasurable
have hi := @yui_aux_0087 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b D (KdVPlan.dt u) hab hdm hae

arguments.statement:
∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ), 0 < τ →
KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b →
(∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => v r k) (KdVPlan.dt v t k) t) ∧
(∃ p : Finset ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, t ∉ p → ∀ k,
HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.interp τ f r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.interp τ f) t k) t ∧
HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.err τ f v r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v) t k) t)
arguments.proof:
intro M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg
have hv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => v r k) (KdVPlan.dt v t k) t := by
  intro t ht k
  have hti : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) := ⟨hg.1.trans_lt ht.1,ht.2.trans_le hg.2.2.1⟩
  exact (((htr.2.2.1.1 k).differentiableOn (by simp) t ⟨hti.1.le,hti.2.le⟩).differentiableAt (Icc_mem_nhds hti.1 hti.2)).hasDerivAt
refine ⟨hv,?_⟩
have hpp := (h_T007.2.2.2 τ f L hτ htr.1 htr.2.1).1
have hp' := (@yui_aux_0089 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).2.1 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) a b _ hg.1 hg.2.2.1 hpp
rcases @yui_aux_0107 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 a b _ hp' with ⟨p,hp⟩
refine ⟨p,?_⟩
intro t ht htp k
have hV := hp t ht htp k
have he := ((hv t ht k).sub hV).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
refine ⟨hV,?_⟩
simpa only [KdVPlan.err,KdVPlan.dt,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.sub_def] using he

helper.statement:
∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ), 0 < τ →
KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b →
(∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => v r k) (KdVPlan.dt v t k) t) ∧
(∃ p : Finset ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, t ∉ p → ∀ k,
HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.interp τ f r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.interp τ f) t k) t ∧
HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.err τ f v r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v) t k) t)
helper.application: @yui_aux_0131 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement:
∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ),
0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (KdVPlan.err τ f v) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v)) ∧
KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (KdVPlan.err τ f v) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v)) ≤ C*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)
arguments.proof:
classical
intro M hM
rcases @yui_aux_0124 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cr,hCr,hRl⟩
rcases h_T005.1.1 with ⟨B,hB,hi,hm,hBB,hJ⟩
let D := B*(M+1)+Cr
have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
refine ⟨1+D,by positivity,?_⟩
intro τ L f v a b hτ hτ1 htr hg hE
have hh := @yui_aux_0120 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg
have hE0 := hh.2.2.2.2.1
have hq0 : 0 ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v := add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le _) hE0
have hr := hRl τ L f v a b hτ hτ1 htr hg hE
have hrAE0 := @yui_aux_0108 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b _ hr.1
have hrAE : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)), KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t) (Cr*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) :=
  hrAE0.mono (fun t ht => ⟨ht.1,ht.2.trans hr.2⟩)
rcases @yui_aux_0114 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L hτ with ⟨p,hp⟩
have hae : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)), KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v) t) (D*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) := by
  rw [← restrict_Ioo_eq_restrict_Icc] at hrAE ⊢
  have hpn : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Ioo a b)), t ∉ (p : Set ℝ) :=
    ae_mono Measure.restrict_le_self (p.finite_toSet.countable.ae_notMem volume)
  filter_upwards [hrAE,hpn,ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t hrt htp hti
  have htc : t ∈ Set.Icc a b := ⟨hti.1.le,hti.2.le⟩
  have htG : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) := ⟨hg.1.trans_lt hti.1,hti.2.trans_le hg.2.2.1⟩
  have hcell := hp t ⟨htG.1.le,htG.2.le⟩ htp
  have he := hh.2.2.2.1 t htc
  have hv := hh.2.2.2.2.2.1 t htc
  have hse := (@yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).2.1 0 _ (1/2) _ he
  have hhalf : ‖(1/2 : ℂ)‖=(1/2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  rw [hhalf] at hse
  have hgb := ((@yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).1 0 _ _ _ _ hv hse).2
  have hgB : KdVPlan.HB 0 (v t-KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.err τ f v t)) (M+1) :=
    ⟨hgb.1,hgb.2.trans (by linarith only [hE])⟩
